notes.title: Game is out now!
notes.notes:
One hour
One global leaderboard
A bunch of melodies to shoot with
Some unique and "smooth if mastered" movement mechanics

Enjoy!

notes.title: OHSL releases 16th February, and a Demo is available right now!
notes.notes:
Hey,

Release is in less than a month! Friday 16th February 2024.
And there is a Demo now available to try it out. Hope you like it!

The Demo is still not completely clean so if you see bugs/feedback please come share them on the [url=https://discord.gg/5CN3KwF]Discord[/url].
